instructions.goal: Convert this brainstorm into a structured mind map. Group related ideas under clear branches and keep titles short.
rules: Keep every existing node id exactly as provided.
Use only these roles: theme, main-branch, branch, leaf, task, idea, question, risk.
Fill the map tree only; never modify or return the brainstorm tree.
Assign a role to every node from the closed role set.
Give first-level branches an explicit side ("left" or "right") to balance the map.

returnContract: Return ONE JSON file: a template document (kind "template") whose root is the new mind map. Set "sourceProjectId" to "p-launch-ideas". Do not include the brainstorm tree.
